title: The Wrath of God
definition: The wrath of God is His holy and righteous opposition to sin and evil.
summary: God's wrath is not uncontrolled rage. It is His settled, just, and holy response to wickedness.
christFocus: Jesus bore the judgment deserved by sinners so that those who trust Him may be rescued from wrath.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: God's wrath is not uncontrolled rage. It is His settled, just, and holy response to wickedness.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers know God rightly, trust Him more deeply, and follow Christ with clarity instead of confusion.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, bring it into prayer, compare it with Scripture, and let it shape your worship, obedience, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
